definition_quote.value: "Practice dietetics" means to apply the principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, biochemistry, physiology, management science, behavioral science, and social science to human nutrition.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice dietetics" means to apply the principles derived from integrating knowledge of food, biochemistry, physiology, management science, behavioral science, and social science to human nutrition.

value: Assessing individual and community food practices and nutritional status using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and demographic data
Developing, establishing, and evaluating nutritional care plans
Nutrition counseling and education as a part of preventive or restorative health care throughout the life cycle
Determining, applying, and evaluating standards for food and nutrition services
Applying scientific research to the role of food in the maintenance of health and the treatment of disease
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice dietetics" includes: Assessing individual and community food practices and nutritional status using anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, dietary, and demographic data, for clinical, research, and program planning purposes; Developing, establishing, and evaluating nutritional care plans that establish priorities, goals, and objectives for meeting nutrient needs for individuals or groups; Nutrition counseling and education as a part of preventive or restorative health care throughout the life cycle; Determining, applying, and evaluating standards for food and nutrition services; and Applying scientific research to the role of food in the maintenance of health and the treatment of disease.
